_comment: Known failures for the PyTorch c10d_nccl2 suite (SUITES in test_pytorch_c10d.py). Keys are "Class.test" as reported in the JUnit XML. Same rules as known_failures.json: an entry is excluded from the verdict so a new failure stays visible, it is not a statement that the test is expected to fail forever, and each entry should name a ticket or cause. Remove an entry once its cause is resolved; the harness logs entries that now pass. Baselined 2026-11-15 from the PR #15864 runs: develop at the v2.32.6 sync fork point (RCCL 2.32.3) and the v2.32.6 sync branch, torch 2.16 nightlies 20261113 and 20261115, MI300X (TheRock CI runners) and MI350X (Ruby).

categories.coalescing_window_timeout: Hits the 600 s pytest-timeout in every run (16/16: 8 develop, 8 sync; MI300X and MI350X). Cause not yet determined (AICOMRCCL-3665). PyTorch then skips the rest of ProcessGroupNCCL2Test ('Previous test failed'); the harness reports those as NOT RUN.
categories.future_not_completed: Worker raises 'TimeoutError: future not completed' in every run (16/16, both GPUs, RCCL 2.32.3 and 2.32.6). Cause not yet determined (AICOMRCCL-3665).
categories.teardown_hang_after_class_failure: The test body is skipped because an earlier test in its class failed, then the class teardown errors with 'ranks [...] did not exit within 300s' (16/16). It says nothing about the test itself. test_timeout_without_process_abort is the ROCM-32381 reproducer (ncclCommAbort hang on the DDA-IPC path, fix #11245 on develop); these runs cannot validate that fix because the body never runs. Remove when the class's first failure is fixed. Tracked in AICOMRCCL-3665.
categories.flight_recorder_dump_on_timeout: Flight-recorder dump on watchdog timeout: test_flight_recorder_dumped_on_timeout fails with 'DistBackendError: Watchdog caught collective operation timeout'; test_flight_recorder_dump_is_bounded with 'no trace written', then a teardown hang (16/16, both GPUs). Cause not yet determined; c10d_nccl's flight-recorder known failures (trace_*, missing_dump_pipe) may share it. Tracked in AICOMRCCL-3665.
